normalization: divide authored pulse by its maximum absolute sample; damping changes normalized shape/spectrum, not predicted absolute power

spectrum.note: Finite smooth window has spectral tails; bandwidth measured from authored discrete samples, not ENP3 specification

limits: no diffraction, beam spreading, shear conversion, transducer response, receiver filter, noise or multiple interfaces
input receiver trace does not uniquely reconstruct full field
display gain is separate from physical amplitude; normalization prevents absolute-output prediction
